LOW_HarperConfrontation_Captain
Captain Leafsong is a high elven druid and a high-ranking[1] member of the Harpers in Act Three. He joins  Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge, should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage.
“
Greetings, Bhaalspawn. I hoped to see the High Harper walk out those doors with you.
„
— Captain Leafsong greeting the Dark Urge.

Involvement

Temple of Bhaal

Should the Dark Urge defeat  Orin the Red and embrace Bhaal's gift, becoming the latter's Chosen, the Harpers set up an ambush at the entrance of the Temple of Bhaal, provided  Jaheira is alive.

Led by Jaheira and accompanied by  Minsc (if rescued), the Harpers stand guard on the bridge leading out of the temple, preventing the party from leaving. The party members then have a brief exchange with Jaheira concerning the Dark Urge's role as the Chosen of Bhaal. Should Minsc be present, the party can use his Mind Flayer Tadpole to force him to stab Jaheira in the back. Doing so immediately kills Jaheira, and triggers combat with Minsc, Leafsong, and the rest of the Harpers.

  • [WISDOM] Ease his confusion. Try to control him. (DC 25)

Alternatively, if the Dark Urge withdraws from Minsc's mind, Jaheira can potentially convince  Gale (if under 20 approval),  Karlach (if under 40 approval), or  Wyll (always) to turn their side, forcing the party to kill them in the ensuing fight with the Harpers.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Hold Person ( + )

Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't Move, Act, or React. Attacks from within 3 m / 10 ft are always Critical Hits.

At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a  Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Lesser Restoration ( + )

Cure a creature from  Diseased,  Poisoned,  Paralysis, or  Blinded.

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Scimitar
Damage: 3~8
1d6 + 2⁠Slashing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Polymorph ( + )

Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.

If the sheep's Hit Points drop to 0, the target reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Sunbeam ( + )
Damage: 6~48
6d8⁠Radiant

A beam of brilliant light sears and  Blinds all creatures in its path.

Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a spell slot.

 CON Save
 Thorn Whip ()
Damage: 1~6
1d6⁠Piercing
Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you.
 Range: 9 m (30 ft)
 Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon ( + 2 )

Take the shape of an Earth Myrmidon.

Your earth myrmidon shape has a starting health of 103 hit points that increases every two druid levels. It can cast  Muck to Metal,  Sludgy Sling, and  Burrow.

Notes

  • Unlike other Harpers, Leafsong and his nearby Harpers do not conform to their organization's brown and blue colour patterns. Instead, Leafsong, as well as  Freddo and  Sulian, wear  Druid Leather Armour identical to the ones worn by the Circle of the Emerald Grove and their insignias.
  • Leafsong serves as a contingency failsafe for the Harper ambush outside the Temple of Bhaal. He can take the lead in talking with the Dark Urge during the confrontation in the event that either  Jaheira or  Minsc died in the temple.
    • However, as the confrontation can only be triggered if Jaheira is still alive, there are no natural ways to trigger his dialogue with the party, or the encounter without Jaheira's involvement.

References

  1. ↑ Leafsong is one of only two Harpers in the game to be given or referred to with a rank - the other being  Jaheira herself, who is referred to as a Commander at Last Light Inn.
